programs.name: 2-Step Pro10
programs.drawdown_type: static (10% of account size; does not trail)
programs.payout_frequency: first payout 21 days after the first funded trade, then every 21 days; every 14 days with the 14-Day Payout add-on
programs.payout_rules_note: Minimum payout $200 via Rise or $50 via USDT-ERC20 (crypto only if Rise is not an option). Evaluation fee refunded once: with the second payout for accounts bought on or after 2026-05-08 (first payout before that). If the account fails within 48 hours of a payout request, the payout is denied and credited back to the balance. Funded phase: max risk per trade idea 2% of initial balance ($1,000 on 50K); news-influenced profits capped at 30% of total profit (payout delayed until below). Payout Guarantee: $500 cash + $500 credit if a payout is not processed within 2 business days (exclusions apply).
programs.notes: Phase 1 target 10% ($5,000), Phase 2 5% ($2,500). Daily loss 5% of the day's starting balance; equity or balance must not reach it. Minimum 4 trading days per phase (8 total) and 2 in the funded phase. Leverage 1:50 on FX majors. Homepage shows $430 and $215 (50% lower) for 50K; $430 is treated as list because the checkout shows the first homepage figure as the regular price for Instant. Variant 2-Step Pro6: targets 6%/6%, daily 3%, max 6% static, 50K list $259. A newer help article describes '2-Step Day' (same targets/limits, no minimum days in the challenge, weekend closing required except crypto) and '2-Step Swing' (weekend holding allowed, split 70%/80%/90% on 1st/2nd/3rd+ payout); prices for these were not shown. Reset after failing Phase 1 costs 60% off the original cost (one reset per challenge).

programs.name: 1-Step (1-Step Pro)
programs.drawdown_type: trailing on balance (10% below the highest recorded balance)
programs.consistency_rule: largest profit day must be at most 50% of total profit; if exceeded you keep trading until compliant
programs.payout_frequency: first payout 21 days after the first funded trade, then every 21 days; every 14 days with the add-on
programs.payout_rules_note: Minimum payout $200 (Rise) or $50 (USDT-ERC20). Evaluation fee refunded once with the second payout for accounts bought on or after 2026-05-08. Max risk per trade idea 2% of initial balance ($1,000 on 50K) in both challenge and funded phases. Funded commissions $3 per lot round trip (except indices) unless the Zero Fees add-on is bought. Payout denied and credited back if the account fails within 48 hours of the request.
programs.notes: Daily loss 3% of account size measured from the day's starting equity. The help article (dated 2026-09-18) gives 2 minimum trading days in Phase 1 and 2 in the funded phase; the homepage pricing card says 4. Help article does not say whether the trailing max loss stops trailing. Homepage shows $329 and $165 for 50K.

programs.name: Instant Funded
programs.drawdown_type: trailing from highest recorded balance until the account is 3% in profit, then locked at the initial account size; does not reset on payout
programs.consistency_rule: largest profit day must be at most 15% of total profit
programs.profit_split: 100% (help article for accounts bought on or after 2026-10-08); homepage card says 90-100%, Terms of Service say 90% (100% with add-on)
programs.payout_frequency: on demand once eligible (help article for accounts from 2026-10-08); Terms of Service and the add-ons article describe a 14-day cycle with an On-Demand add-on
programs.payout_rules_note: To request a payout the balance must be at least 3.5% above the initial size (3% cushion stays in the account and is not withdrawable; 0.5% withdrawable), consistency score 15% or lower, no open positions. Minimum $200 (Rise) or $50 (USDT-ERC20). Max risk per trade 1% of initial balance ($500 on 50K). Fee is not refundable by default; the help article describes a 200% refund bonus paid with the second payout, and checkout lists '200% Refund Bonus' as a +20% add-on.
programs.notes: No evaluation. Daily loss 3% of account size from the higher of the day's starting balance or equity. Opening or closing a trade within 5 minutes before or after a high-impact (red folder) release leads to termination (Terms of Service say 10 minutes). Weekend holding allowed per the 2026-10-08 rules (the older General Trading Guidelines required closing before Friday). Terms of Service cap lots at 20 per trade. Checkout (app.fundingtraders.com) lists Instant 50K at $479; homepage shows $479 and $240. Sizes $5K-$400K.

news_trading: Restricted: challenge phases unrestricted. 1-Step/2-Step funded accounts: trades opened, held or closed within 5 minutes of a high-impact release count as news trades and may make up at most 30% of total profit (payout delayed until below; trades opened 5+ hours before the release are exempt). Instant Funded: no opening or closing within 5 minutes before/after high-impact news (termination); a News Holding add-on allows holding through events
ea_bots_allowed: Restricted: only EAs/bots used for risk management; EAs that place trades are not permitted unless personally developed by the trader (help center) or approved by the Risk Team (Terms); grid, hedge, martingale, arbitrage and off-the-shelf bots prohibited
copy_trading: Restricted: allowed between your own FundingTraders accounts under the same verified profile; copying other traders or signal services and sharing signals are prohibited
overnight_weekend_holding: 1-Step, 2-Step Pro and 2-Step Swing: overnight and weekend allowed. 2-Step Day: forex, gold, indices and oil must be closed before Friday close (crypto may stay open). Instant Funded (2026-10-08 rules): overnight and weekend allowed. Trades of 15 seconds or less and a volume-weighted average hold time under 2 minutes are prohibited
restricted_countries_note: Funding Traders publishes two different restricted-country lists: a longer one in its Terms of Service and a shorter one in its help center (dated July 14, 2026). Check both before buying. It says MT5 is not intended for US residents.
payout_methods: Crypto USDT-ERC20 via Coinbase Commerce (min $50, only if Rise is not an option)

affiliate_program.commission: Tier 1 Starter: 15% new / 10% recurring / 5% influenced / 5% assisted; Tier 2 Ambassador (50 referrals, $300 one-time bonus): 20% / 10% / 7% / 5%; Tier 3 VIP (100 referrals, $1,000 bonus, lifetime attribution): 25% / 15% / 10% / 7%
affiliate_program.notes: Participation subject to FundingTraders approval. $100 minimum withdrawal, once every 14 days, KYC required; commissions pending 7 days. Attribution 90 days (Starter), 180 days (Ambassador), lifetime (VIP). Paid ads (Google Ads, YouTube Ads, Facebook/Instagram Ads, sponsored placements) and self-referrals are prohibited. Serbia: the partner terms and partner help articles do not mention Serbia or any country eligibility rule; Serbia is not on the site-wide restricted list, so not stated either way for affiliates. Partner terms: https://fundingtraders.com/partners-terms-of-service
